description: React component for displaying and editing default user settings, including fetching from backend APIs, rendering schema-based UI, and supporting editing and saving capabilities.

methods.name: fetchSSOSettings
methods.description: Fetches user settings and available models from backend APIs when component loads or accessToken changes.

methods.name: handleSaveSettings
methods.description: Processes and saves edited user settings back to the backend.

methods.name: handleTextInputChange
methods.description: Updates local edited values state when user input changes.

methods.name: normalizeTeams
methods.description: Normalizes team data to a consistent format.

methods.name: renderTeamsEditor
methods.description: Renders UI for adding, editing, and removing teams.

methods.name: renderEditableField
methods.description: Renders appropriate input control for each setting property based on its schema type.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Displays the current value of each setting property, formatted for readability.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Dynamically renders all settings based on the schema and current values.
